name: predict_admet
description: Predict ADMET properties (absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity) for a molecule using RDKit and Lipinski rule-of-5
usage: from app.tools.biomni.pharmacology import predict_admet; result = predict_admet('CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O')

parameters.smiles: str — SMILES string of the molecule

returns: dict with keys: smiles, mw, logp, hbd, hba, rotatable_bonds, tpsa, lipinski_pass, predicted_properties
